_why: Offline smoke cases for lib/verbs/zh.py, taken from dict/zh.db built 2026-09-10 (with entry.head). `forms` are the entry's own rows the recipe reads -- the headword row, the `canonical` split row and the `Simplified-Chinese` row -- in rowid order: inserted in that order into a scratch db they are the entry's own block, and the recipe gives `expect` from them with a hit that carries only headword and entry (head_sound falls back to entry.translit, which is the pinyin). Two cases (想到, 听懂) also read lib/lang/zh.verbs.json, the hand table, which the recipe reads from lib/lang/ as it does in the server. expect null = recipe returns None (no vb).

cases.what: a separable verb-object verb (vo): split 睡了觉, the 了 said with the half before it; the archaic 睡覺 shuìjué is another entry

entry.sense:
to sleep; to go to bed
to sleep with each other; to have sexual intercourse
entry.head: {"type": "vo"}

expect.plain: 睡觉 shuìjiào · split 睡了觉 shuìle jiào · to sleep

cases.what: a verb with a complement (vc): can't 看不见, one word in pinyin with bu toneless

expect.plain: 看见 kànjiàn · can't 看不见 kànbujiàn · to see

cases.what: vo1 with a two-syllable object and a space in the pinyin: 开了玩笑 kāile wánxiào

entry.sense: to joke; to kid; to make a joke; to joke around
entry.head: {"type": "vo"}

expect.tex: \vb{开玩笑}{kāi wánxiào}{开了玩笑}{kāile wánxiào}{}{}{to joke}
expect.plain: 开玩笑 kāi wánxiào · split 开了玩笑 kāile wánxiào · to joke
expect.line: split 开了玩笑 kāile wánxiào

cases.what: typed vo by Wiktionary (想⫽到), corrected to vc by lib/lang/zh.verbs.json: 想不到, never *想了到

entry.sense: to think of; to call to mind; to anticipate; to occur (to somebody); to suspect
entry.head: {"type": "vo"}

expect.plain: 想到 xiǎngdào · can't 想不到 xiǎngbudào · to think of

cases.what: no zh-verb type at all; a complement verb only through lib/lang/zh.verbs.json (听⫽懂)

expect.plain: 听懂 tīngdǒng · can't 听不懂 tīngbudǒng · to understand by listening

cases.what: a plain verb with no type: every other Chinese verb stays \dw -> None

entry.sense:
to know (something); to be aware of
to understand
